execution.implementation: public PDB 6OIM coordinate retrieval and deterministic residue-level structure-quality analysis plus a separate Rosalind launcher observation; no Rosalind scientific job executed

observations: Public PDB 6OIM is a 1.65 Å X-ray structure of KRAS G12C covalently bound to MOV (AMG 510).
Chain A contains 167 observed residue records; residues 105-107 and 170-189 are absent within the reviewed 1-189 span.
Cys12 is 1.805 Å from the nearest MOV atom, and switch II has a mean crystallographic B factor of 29.300 Å².
interpretation: Absent coordinates and relatively elevated crystallographic B factors identify regions that deserve added caution when a prediction is interpreted.
Crystallographic B factors are experimental-model properties, not prediction confidence scores.
limitations: 6OIM is one ligand-bound crystallographic state and does not represent every KRAS G12C conformation.
The analysis does not generate or validate a prediction and has no clinical interpretation.
The Rosalind call verified launcher readiness only and executed no scientific job.

provenance.note: The builder computes the scientific outputs from retained public coordinates. outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json records the genuine mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open call separately and states that no scientific job executed.

reproduction: Run python build_case.py to retrieve PDB 6OIM and regenerate the metrics and preview.
Confirm 167 chain-A residue records, resolution 1.65 Å, and the retained regional B-factor values.
Inspect outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json separately as launcher-readiness evidence.
